title: Milton Flats Rising
author: D. M. Galloway
blurb: Hazel Zhou, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the demolition date arrives.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
